name: Work Tracking
description: Track tasks and work items with custom objects, fields, and validation rules

initialMessages.content: I want to build a work tracking app on Salesforce. It should have work items with title, description, assignee, priority (Low/Medium/High/Critical), and status (Open/In Progress/Blocked/Done). I need validation rules — like requiring a description before moving to In Progress, and blocking Critical items from being unassigned. I also want filtered views by status, assignee, and priority, plus an activity timeline on each item.

I'll build that for you. The project has a React frontend and Salesforce metadata scaffolding ready to go. I'll start with the data model and a basic list view, then layer on validation rules and filtering. Here goes!
